raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: After the WebSurfer confirmed that John, Count Palatine of Neumarkt, was the son of Rupert III of the Palatinate, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Catherine’s father-in-law was John the Fearless, Duke of Burgundy. This contradicts the evidence; Catherine’s father-in-law should be Rupert (Rupert III, King of the Romans).
